scope: cross-fitted site-balanced L1 ranker on fold/sensor-invariant honest dense-Prithvi features from folds 3 and 4

normalization.input: unlabeled empirical rank followed by inverse-normal transform within each fold x sensor
normalization.head_output: the cross-fitted linear decision function is independently rank/inverse-normal normalized within each held fold x sensor
normalization.purpose: remove raw adapter, fold, sensor, and classifier-calibration offsets while retaining within-domain ranking

weighting_definitions.site_equal: every physical site has equal total training weight
weighting_definitions.site_label_equal: every physical site has equal total weight and each label cell present within a site has equal weight
weighting_definitions.site_sensor_label_equal: every physical site has equal total weight and each sensor x label cell present within a site has equal weight

crossfit.model_selection: rank candidates only after concatenating the two honest held-fold predictions

target_domain.name: low-prevalence physical-location proxy for the official test-only-site view
target_domain.membership: all rows from physical_location_id groups whose combined folds-3/4 positive rate is <=0.05
target_domain.use: evaluation and candidate gating only; site prevalence is never an inference feature or routing condition

invariants: Every represented sample comes from a dense adapter that excluded that sample's fold.
Every linear prediction comes from a classifier fit only on the opposite fold.
Neither input nor held-head normalization uses labels.
Physical-site labels affect training weights only inside the fit fold.
Low-prevalence labels define evaluation strata only and never enter the model or inference routing.
The exact current score remains the zero-residual logit floor.
Only point-gate survivors can consume paired-site bootstrap computation.
Both whole-development and low-prevalence paired-site AP lower bounds must be strictly positive.
A development pass can only authorize a separately frozen fold-2 confirmation.
Fold 2, fresh data, and exact-paper inputs are never loaded.
